rows.current_route_body_anchor:
**(c) Modes.** A **mode** of the radiation sector is a nonzero class
$\varphi\in\mathfrak h$ considered up to phase, equivalently the rank-one
orthogonal projection onto $\mathbb C\varphi$; a **declared mode family** is a
finite or countable orthonormal family $(\varphi_{j})$ of $\mathfrak h$
([[def-orthonormal-family-complete-orthonormal-system-and-hilbert-basis]]). For
a unit mode vector $\varphi$ and $z\in\mathbb C$ the vector
$$U_\varphi\psi_z,\qquad \psi_z=e^{-|z|^{2}/2}\sum_{n\in\mathbb N}\frac{z^{n}}{\sqrt{n!}}e_n,$$
is the **mode-coherent preparation vector of label $z$**, and $U_\varphi e_n$
is the **$n$-quanta mode vector**; these are the readings of the transferred
vectors of [[lem-nrqm-photons-fixed-mode-number-isometry]]. A mode vector is a
normalisable wave packet; the sharp-mode label $k$ of the propagation-mode
idealisation is a spectral parameter and is not a state of $\mathfrak h$
([[lem-nrqm-photons-transverse-restricted-momentum-and-energy-multipliers]]
clause (c)).

- **What the lemma is not.** The lemma is finite-dimensional linear algebra:
  no dynamics, no measurement postulate and no physical identification of
  $e_{\theta}$ with an apparatus direction is asserted. The physical reading of
  the projections as the outcome structure of a polarisation analyser is fixed
  in [[def-nrqm-photons-framework-fixed-mode-polarization-model]].
- **The identity $\cos^{2}(\theta-\varphi)$ is classical and quantum at once.**
  The same projection formula governs the classical transverse field amplitude
  and the quantised polarisation amplitude; the comparison, and the reason that
  the coincidence of the numbers does not establish field quantisation, is the
  subject of the companion examples page of this pair, which is not a
  prerequisite of this lemma.

observable $H_f=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}T_{n}$ with $\varepsilon(k)=\hbar c|k|$ and

read in the dimensionless unit $1$ of counted quanta, and the total momentum
components $\bigoplus_n\bigl(\sum_{i=1}^{n}\hbar k_{j,i}\bigr)$, read in

self-adjointness are the mathematics of
[[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-transverse-continuum-free-fock-hamiltonian]]
and [[thm-nrqm-fock-and-equilibrium-number-operator-domain]] for energy and
number, and [[lem-nrqm-photons-transverse-fock-total-momentum]] for total
momentum, read physically in
[[def-nrqm-photons-framework-radiation-sector-and-quantum-assignments]].
The total momentum components use the maximal signed summed-multiplier
sector domains and the squared-norm summability Fock domain of that lemma;
the vacuum has total momentum zero.

rows.current_route_body_anchor: 4.1 [Why the comparison does not discriminate and what would] Steps 1.1 and 2.1 show equality of the two declared normalised two-bin laws for every datum; the equality of one class of predictions of two distinct models is not evidence for either, and it does not establish field quantisation. A discriminating comparison must therefore be designed on a prediction where the two declared models differ, with the detector response, preparation and sampling model declared in the sense of [F5]; no such comparison is constructed here and no data is reported. This proves (c) and (d). [step 1.1, step 2.1, step 3.1, F5] ∎
